subject: MAP & custody action plan — Oakridge eval dataset exchange
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Park <claire.park@oakridge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP & custody action plan — Oakridge eval dataset exchange

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for the chat this morning. Per our discussion, I’ve sketched a short mutual action plan (MAP) to get Oakridge’s evaluation suite into a Redwood pilot sandbox with explicit usage limits and a takedown cadence. High-level asks / commitments below: 

- Oakridge: provide the evaluation testcases (anonymized CSV) and a short README with provenance notes by 2026-05-12.
- Redwood: provision ephemeral sandbox, ingest files, run an acceptance smoke test, and share access instructions by 2026-05-18.
- Both: sign the MAP (DocuSign) by 2026-05-20 to lock in the custody, retention, and destruction clauses.

Please confirm the acceptance window and any special constraints (PII, vendor-only access, no redistribution, etc.). I’ve copied Marissa for ops coordination.

Attachments: none in this note — will follow up with a formal MAP workbook.

Next step: can you send the first sample bundle (<= 2GB) and the README? If you prefer, you can upload to the Drive link below.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

From: Claire Park <claire.park@oakridge.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & custody action plan — Oakridge eval dataset exchange

Hi Vanessa —

Appreciate the outline. We’re good to proceed with the timeline but two constraints up front:

1) The testcases include internal customer excerpts that must be redacted; we’ll provide an anonymized CSV.
2) Usage limited to the Redwood ephemeral sandbox for evaluation only — no model training, no external sharing outside Oakridge and Redwood.

I’m attaching the first bundle (oakridge_testcases_v1.csv) and a short README (README_testcases_v1.txt). We’ve marked rows with provenance tags and a sample masking note.

Attachment stubs: oakridge_testcases_v1.csv (CSV, 78KB); README_testcases_v1.txt (TXT, 2KB)

We’ll review the MAP workbook once you share. If we can get access for two Oakridge reviewers (Claire Park and Tom Lee) at the same time as your smoke tests, that would help speed acceptance.

Best,
Claire Park
Head of Data Partnerships, Oakridge Analytics
claire.park@oakridge.ai | +1 206-555-9876

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Park <claire.park@oakridge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & custody action plan — Oakridge eval dataset exchange

Claire —

Received the bundle, thank you — we ran a quick checksum and the sample looks in order. Attached is the MAP workbook (MAP_Oakridge_v1.xlsx) that captures the acceptance gates, responsibilities, and the takedown schedule (Section 4). Key items I highlighted:

- Acceptance gate A (ingest + smoke test): target 2026-05-18 (Redwood).
- Acceptance gate B (Oakridge verification): target 2026-05-20 (Oakridge reviewers: Claire, Tom).
- Retention & destruction: data will be ephemeral in sandbox; full wipe scheduled 7 days after final acceptance unless longer retention is explicitly requested in writing.
- Usage constraints: evaluation-only, no training, no export of raw testcases, and access limited to listed Oakridge emails + Redwood ops.

Marissa — can you provision the ephemeral sandbox and create reviewer accounts for Claire and Tom with MFA and access expiry set to 2026-05-27? Upload the MAP workbook to the shared Drive folder linked below.

Attachments: MAP_Oakridge_v1.xlsx (XLSX, 54KB)

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cOakridge-MAP

Thanks —
Vanessa

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & custody action plan — Oakridge eval dataset exchange

Vanessa —

Thanks for circulating the MAP workbook. A couple of legal notes / suggested edits on usage constraints that Oakridge should accept before DocuSign: 

- Tighten the definition of "evaluation-only" to explicitly prohibit transfer to third-party contractors and to disallow any model retraining increments derived from the dataset.
- Add a short audit clause: Redwood will provide an audit log extract (ingest + access) on request within 5 business days; Oakridge may request this no more than twice during the pilot.
- Clarify destruction mechanics: specify a verification step (ops-run wipe + signed confirmation email) rather than ambiguous language.

I drafted a quick redline (redlines_usage_terms_v1.docx). Marissa — can you attach the redline to the MAP workbook before we send DocuSign? We should keep the deal timeline but avoid opening broad reuse rights.

On the timeline: these changes are low-lift; if Oakridge agrees, we can keep the current dates and proceed to signature.

Ben Carter
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Claire Park <claire.park@oakridge.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Lee <tom.lee@oakridge.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & custody action plan — Oakridge eval dataset exchange

Vanessa / Ben —

Thanks for the swift turnaround. Oakridge accepts the edits proposed by Ben (no training, no third-party transfers, audit extract twice during pilot, formal verification on destruction). We’re ready to sign the MAP — I’ve authorized Tom to countersign.

I’ll click through the DocuSign link once you send the envelope. Per the MAP, we’ll expect the sandbox access for Claire and Tom and the ingestion smoke test results by 2026-05-18.

Agreed attachments to be part of the exchange: oakridge_testcases_v1.csv; MAP_Oakridge_v1.xlsx; redlines_usage_terms_v1.docx

Best,
Claire
